description:
Analysis extent for Tropical cyclone, Fiji, 19 February 2016 (TC20160219FJI): 7 features merged from 7 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Damage Assessment in Greater Lautoka Area, Ba Province, Western Division, Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-in-greater-lautoka-area-ba-province-western-divi-february-25-2016)
- [Geodata of Damage Assessment in Sasa Area, Ba Province, Western Division, Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-in-sasa-area-ba-province-western-division-fiji-march-03-2016)
- [Geodata of Damage Assessment in Vatukoula Area, Ba Province, Western Division, Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-in-vatukoula-area-ba-province-western-division-f-march-02-2016)
- [Geodata of Damage Assessment over north and west of Ba Town, Ba Province, Western Division, Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-over-north-and-west-of-ba-town-ba-province-weste-march-03-2016)
- [Geodata of Population Exposure Analysis - Tropical Cyclone Winston - 19 February 2016](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-population-exposure-analysis-tropical-cyclone-winston-19-february-march-09-2016)
- [Geodata of Population Exposure Analysis - Tropical Cyclone Winston - 22 February 2016](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-population-exposure-analysis-tropical-cyclone-winston-22-february-march-09-2016)
- [Geodata of Satellite Detected Waters in Savu Area, Naitasiri Province, Central Division, Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-satellite-detected-waters-in-savu-area-naitasiri-province-central-february-22-2016)
- [Geodata of UNOSAT Damage Assessment Activities in Viti Levu Island, Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-unosat-damage-assessment-activities-in-viti-levu-island-fiji-march-10-2016)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Water_Class
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Preflood Water; 1 = Flood Water; 2 = Flood-Affected Land / Possible Flood water; 3 = Probable Flash Flood-Affected Land; 4 = Satellite Detected Waters; 6 = Possible Saturated, wet Soil/ possible Flood Water; 9 = Aquaculture (Wet Rice); 14 = Tsunami-Affected Land; 99 = Maximum Flood Water Extent (Cumulative). The decoded text is in `Water_Class_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Worldview-1; 2 = Worldview-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = Komsat-2; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleadies; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `Sensor_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_Date
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Confidence_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `Confidence_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Field_Validation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `Field_Validation_label`.

table:columns.name: Water_StatusID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = New Water / Water Increase; 2 = No water change / Static Level; 3 = No water / Water levels decreased. The decoded text is in `Water_StatusID_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: SenorID_old
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = MODIS; 2 = ASAR WSM; 3 = ASAR IMP; 4 = Radarsat; 5 = DMC; 6 = SPOT5; 7 = ALOS Palsar WB1; 8 = ASAR APP. The decoded text is in `SenorID_old_label`.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Confidence_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Confidence_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Field_Validation_label
table:columns.description: `Field_Validation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SenorID_old_label
table:columns.description: `SenorID_old` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Sensor_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Water_Class_label
table:columns.description: `Water_Class` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Water_StatusID_label
table:columns.description: `Water_StatusID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT 6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Komsat-2; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
